component.name: Vessel
component.summary: Local-first, cross-platform streaming and media center

description.p: Vessel is a local-first, privacy-respecting streaming and media center built in Rust, Tauri v2, and Vue 3. Extensions execute locally in isolated QuickJS sandboxes, accompanied by an HMAC-authenticated local HTTP/HLS proxy, SQLite FTS5 library persistence, IPTV with XMLTV EPG, skip segments, and concurrent offline downloads.

Added cinemata and hexion shortcodes, moved Extensions right above Settings in the Desktop sidebar, added a Search reset/back button returning to Recent Searches, and overhauled the built-in Subtitles Container with automatic Cinemeta/IMDb enrichment, key-free OpenSubtitles REST and SubDL web providers, accurate TurkceAltyazi.org matching, and fixed Addic7ed/YIFY/Kitsunekko lookup.

Fixed Android APK release signing, removed global transparent window mode causing Linux/Flatpak compositor flickering, isolated QuickJS search cancellation so plugin details/streams never fail with VesselCancelledError, filtered unimplemented subtitle search errors, and fixed macOS embedded libmpv OpenGL/subtitle lifecycle and WebView HLS subtitle/worker playback.
Updated Flatpak runtime and SDK from EOL GNOME 47 to GNOME 51.

Optimized Desktop UI scroll and rendering performance (lazy images, content-visibility rails, micro-batched home feed events), shared process-wide HTTP pool across plugins, raised warm runtime pool cap to 40, fixed Dean Edwards unpacker with leading IIFE scripts, and updated tr/anthology/nuvio repository shortcodes.
Streamed per-plugin Home feed loading so fast shelves render immediately, parallelized open TypeScript plugin module downloads, and added repository iconUrl fallback onto installed plugin manifests.
Standardized Android button/badge sizing with UI density, text scale, and corner style personalization, larger plain Desktop sidebar logo, and removed Desktop route transition progress bar.

Universal third-party Nuvio/Stremio/ESM/TS plugin runtime compatibility fixes (axios.create, FormData, default User-Agent, sanitized headers, Cinemeta episode fallback), true edge-to-edge Android Floating Bottom Navbar, and clean Desktop logo presentation.

6-provider interactive Fix Match search, per-media linked stream sources, opaque splash screens, Hero Watch Now & Ken Burns zoom, Android Continue Watching editor, toggleable Android Floating Bottom Navbar, Live TV favorites & layout customization, and uncapped Live TV plugin catalogs.
Desktop-parity Android Home catalog feed selector, spotlight hero source & shelf ordering, and standard SemVer release.
Desktop-parity Android player, live stream proxy & HLS sniffing fixes, background skip-segment enrichment, Live TV plugins tab first, fullscreen Android mode, and unified Vessel logo.
Smart Continue Watching, multi-provider Skip Segments, 4-level offline download hierarchy, and Linux packaging.
